about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: As a Software Developer with over a decade of experience, I have specialized in developing user interfaces, including web, mobile, and desktop applications, with a particular focus on JavaScript. Additionally, I possess solid experience in backend development, working with a variety of languages and frameworks such as Go, NodeJS, C#, PHP, Serverless.
about.paragraph2: My approach is grounded in the fundamental worth of products, prioritizing user experience, the significance of features, and the efficiency of delivery, firmly believing these elements outweigh others. I understand the difficulties of managing a project that started with developmental shortcomings, therefore, I'm always seeking the ideal equilibrium between swift goal realization and upholding superior code quality.
about.paragraph3: I see myself as genuinely kind and empathetic, valuing a light and pleasant work environment. Humor, for me, is essential in building a comfortable and collaborative space. Through experience, I've come to appreciate the importance of attention to detail, believing it's crucial for crafting successful products.
